parsed.name: SCPI 网络通信组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过 IP 与支持 SCPI/IEEE 488.2 的仪器交互。它提供通用命令发送、状态寄存器读写、身份查询、触发、复位以及二进制块传输等能力，常用于实验系统中统一接入不同型号的网络仪器。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component for interacting with SCPI/IEEE 488.2 compliant instruments over IP. It provides generic command/query handling, status register access, identity queries, triggering, reset, and binary block transfer, and is commonly used to integrate different networked instruments in laboratory setups.
